name: Littoral-Ria

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on fusion fuel, helium-3, antimatter traces and exotic matter are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
